 Oklahoma businessman Bob Mills passes away
 Bob Mills founded his furniture store in 1971. He passed away at 79 years old.
 November 9, 2026 11:39 AM 2 min read 
 OKLAHOMA CITY - Bob Mills, the founder of Bob Mills Furniture, has died, according to a statement released by his family. The family remembered Mills for his dedication to the company, its employees and the relationships he built throughout his career.
 Family Remembers Bob Mills’ Legacy
 In a message to employees, Mills’ family described his passing as an immeasurable loss and reflected on the business he built.
 “Bob built more than a furniture company. He built a legacy rooted in hard work, determination, relationships, and a genuine belief in people,” the family said.
 The statement emphasized Mills’ pride in the employees who helped grow the business and thanked them for their loyalty and dedication.
 Bob Mills Furniture to Continue Operations
 Mills’ family also reassured employees that the company will continue operating following his death.
 The family said Bob Mills Furniture will move forward under the values and commitment that guided the business during his leadership.
 Full statement from Bob Mills’ family
 It is with heavy hearts and profound sadness that we share the passing of our beloved husband, father, and founder of Bob Mills Furniture, Bob Mills. 
 For our family, this is an immeasurable loss. But we also know that his passing will be felt by the countless people whose lives he touched throughout the years. 
 Bob built more than a furniture company. He built a legacy rooted in hard work, determination, relationships, and a genuine belief in people. What began as his dream grew into something far greater than he could have imagined, and each of you has played a part in making that possible. 
 He was incredibly proud of this company, but even more importantly, he was proud of the people who made it what it is today. 
 As his family, we want you to know how deeply grateful we are for your dedication, loyalty, and the role you have played in his life’s work. You are part of his legacy, and that is something we will always cherish. 
 We also want to reassure each of you that Bob Mills Furniture will continue to move forward. The company he worked so hard to build will continue to operate, guided by the same values, dedication, and commitment to 
 excellence that have defined it 
 Statement from David F. Griffin, Chairman and CEO of Oklahoma’s Own Griffin
 “All of us at Griffin Media are incredibly saddened by the passing of Bob Mills. Bob was a dear and wonderful friend to both the Griffin family and our company for many years. He was also a true Oklahoma icon - a business trailblazer, a friend to the community, and an inspirational leader for many. Our thoughts and prayers are with his family during this difficult time.”
